crossRefs.note: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You…
The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according…
You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be…
Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses…
If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.
translations.bsb: No longer may the Israelites come near to the Tent of Meeting, or they will incur guilt and die.
translations.kjv: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
translations.asv: And henceforth the children of Israel shall not come nigh the tent of meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.
